checks.a_analysis: The output does not contain duplicated blocks of content from the source. While headers like 'Permit Number AWG300000' appear multiple times, this is consistent with their appearance on every page of the source document and is categorized as an acceptable repetition.

The heading hierarchy is severely compromised. Major sections V (General Conditions) and VI (Penalties) are incorrectly nested within the element list of Section IV (Inspections and Entry). Specifically, items V.1, V.2, VI.1, VI.2, and VI.3 are rendered as list items under the Section IV heading. Furthermore, subsequent headings for Sections V and VI appear later in the document but are missing these specific items, resulting in a fractured and incorrect structural hierarchy.
checks.b_evidence_output: The items 'Coverage under this General Permit shall not relieve...' (V.1), 'The maximum waste level...' (V.2), and 'Failure to abide by...' (VI.1) are included as items 2, 3, and 4 in the list element of section index 1 (IV. INSPECTIONS AND ENTRY).

checks.a_analysis: The table structure for complex tables, such as Attachment B on page 25, is faithfully preserved. Headers are correctly identified and spanned (e.g., GROUNDWATER CHARACTERISTICS across 2 columns), and row data correctly aligns with the parameter descriptions and standards in the source.

The logical reading order of the document is significantly altered. The first 10 pages of the source document (Performance Standards and initial Operation requirements) are missing from the beginning and instead appear as 'unavailable' placeholder sections at the very end of the JSON. The conversion begins abruptly on Page 11 of the source. This reordering of chunks breaks the logical flow of the permit.
checks.b_evidence_source: The document begins with Section I: Performance Standards (page 2).
checks.b_evidence_output: The JSON starts with content from Page 11 ('d. All steps being taken...'). Sections titled '[Pages 1-6 unavailable]' and '[Pages 6-11 unavailable]' are placed at the end of the sections array.
checks.b_evidence_location: Throughout document; see section indexes 0, 7, and 8.

Additionally, the multi-column lists on page 22 (Production Summary) are flattened into single string list items, losing their categorization structure.
